title: Credo (Gaspar, Missa Octavi toni)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Missa Octavi toni, Credo. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0204c), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. II. Masses, Part 2, 2018); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2016, Kolb, Paul. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
